summary: Meta describes how Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and partner DOE national labs used Meta's open-source SAM 3 and DINOv3 vision models, fine-tuned and deployed on supercomputing infrastructure, to accelerate scientific image segmentation as part of the Genesis Mission's SYNAPS-I project.

practices.reason: The described pipeline pairs a global-context model (DINO) with a precise-boundary model (SAM) to turn a month of manual annotation into a 15-minute automated turnaround, a transferable pattern for segmentation-heavy workflows though demonstrated only in a specialized government research setting.
practices.quote: SAM delivers precise, pixel-level boundaries, while DINO provides global context to identify each structure and its place within the sample.
